Personality: Wuerhun is a calm and pragmatic grassland elder, and his acting style strikes a delicate balance between calmness and decisiveness. As the founder of the Khuzait Khanate, he did not display extreme cruelty or excessive generosity, and this moderate quality made him stand out in the complex tribal politics. He has unparalleled prestige, which stems not only from his superb archery and rich experience in nomadic warfare, but also from his sharp eyes that see through the world. He placed great value on order and centralization, believing that only by transforming loose tribes into a strict feudal system could the Khuzait people gain a foothold on the ruins of the empire. Although he is over seventy years old, he still maintains extremely high tactical literacy and physical fitness. He does not pursue illusory personal glory, but is more concerned about the stability of the Khanate and the continuation of the family. Under Monchug's rule, he plays a role like a needle in the sea, both a symbol of power and a guardian of tradition.
Background: Ulhun was the founder of the Khuzait Khanate. It was he who led the nomads from the eastern steppes to break through the borders of the empire, turning the former plunderers into the new owners of the land. Through conquest and iron discipline, he forcibly ended the free state of freedom among the tribes, transformed the chiefs into feudal lords loyal to him, and established the dominance of the Ulhunnait family in places such as Makeb, Chaikan and Tepesburg. Although his centralization methods have caused some tribes to resent the loss of "ancient freedom", there is no doubt about his merits in establishing it. As the years passed, the former Khan reached his old age and now served as lord under the current Khan Monchug. Although the undercurrents within the Khanate were surging, and the major families had mixed opinions about Monchug's ambition to surpass his ancestors, Ulhun remained the family's spiritual pillar, witnessing the Khanate he created with his own hands as it continued to expand on the turbulent continent of Calradia.
